categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches the P2P label and modifies src/addrman.cpp to fix peer sampling behavior within address manager buckets.
categories.rationale: Eliminates severe sampling bias in sparse address manager buckets that skews peer connection selection. In buckets with few entries, sequential offset scanning created dramatic probability imbalances (e.g. 95.3% vs 4.7% in a two-entry bucket), degrading eclipse resistance and uniform peer connectivity.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Unit and fuzz test additions in src/test/ specifically test addrman sampling behavior rather than test framework infrastructure.
categories.rationale: Not a member because tests verifying behavior of a specific subsystem belong to that subsystem rather than test infrastructure.
